facts.fact: The BCSTP, as regulator of the financial system, has since June 2023 been easing licensing requirements for payment institutions and bureaux de change, and eased some documentation requirements again for twelve months (communiqué of 20 January 2025).
The BCSTP licenses payment institutions, and has eased the documentation required of national entities seeking to formalise, since June 2023 and again for twelve months from January 2025.

STP.note: No survey share of adults with accounts stated.
No mobile money or retail payment service stated as licensed or in service.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
